task.title: Select profiles to compare
task.shortdesc: Search independently for Profile A and Profile B, select rows from bounded result lists, and review each summary.

prereq.p: The Compare surface is open from the Library.

context.p: Each side has its own search field and result list so you can choose profiles with similar names without mixing sides.

step.cmd: Search for Profile A in the left search field and select the intended row.

info.p: Expected result: the left selected-profile summary shows the profile name, schema channel, lifecycle, and status context.

step.cmd: Search for Profile B in the right search field and select the intended row.

info.p: Expected result: the right summary updates independently.

step.cmd: Confirm both summaries before reading the comparison table.

info.note: Do not rely on search result position alone. Confirm identity and schema on both sides.

result.p: Profile A and Profile B are selected and ready for comparison.

postreq.p: Recovery: if one profile is missing, clear that side's search, refresh the Library in the original tab, and confirm the profile is saved.
